[Story]
At a family gathering, the family enjoys delicious food. Mom tells her daughter, Xiao Fang, "Today we prepare 20 dishes, most of them are hot dishes, some are cold dishes, but there are almost no desserts." Xiao Fang looks and finds only 4 cold dishes.

[Question]
Please ask Xiao Fang to guess how many hot dishes there are?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After Xiao Fang looks, she guesses there are 16 hot dishes.
B. After Xiao Fang looks, she guesses there are 12 hot dishes.
C. After Xiao Fang looks, she guesses there are 10 hot dishes.
D. After Xiao Fang looks, she guesses there are 15 hot dishes.
